item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the Department of Transport's response to four recommendations about unauthorised access to its TRELIS database.
item.support: This report describes the actions taken by DoT in addressing these recommendations.

item.text: The earlier recommendations covered access policies, investigation processes, activity alerts and agreements governing external users.
item.support: Review current TRELIS activity alerts to ensure they are contemporary, focused, and effective.

item.text: The Commission concluded that the department had improved its ability to prevent serious misconduct and had adequately addressed all four recommendations.
item.support: The Commission considers the recommendations have been adequately addressed.

item.quote: The Commission considers DoT has taken appropriate steps to address the recommendations.
The Commission considers all recommendations closed.
